papers.title: Observed-data distributions and partial identification of signed beyond-FLRW functionals

Legacy scalar x_C,Q,F,Pi,G_F retained only as declared projections, not the default inference.
papers.minimum_publishable_result: A real data-linked partially identified distribution + sensitivity across denominator/selection assumptions, or a calibrated posterior. No mere mathematical restatement.
papers.existing_evidence: PR066; PR521; MIO/HTT firewall; CF4/Planck real conditional data
papers.principal_blocker: Physical signed x_C has no fully identified common-congruence posterior and no certified total-x anchor
